title: Slovak Sausage Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful dish that combines the spices of Slovakia with the convenience of skewers.

ingredients.name: Slovak sausage
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of sausage you like, but Slovak sausage has a distinct flavor

ingredients.name: nimble skewers
ingredients.notes: You can soak the skewers in water for 30 minutes before using to prevent them from burning

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: You can use any color onion you like

ingredients.name: Bell pepper
ingredients.notes: You can use any color bell pepper you like

ingredients.name: Zucchini
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of zucchini you like

instructions: Thread the sausage onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Thread the onion, bell pepper, and zucchini onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
